basis: The complete third paragraph of XVIII.30 treats Joel separately from the preceding Micah and Jonah paragraphs. It identifies the Spirit-promise as the text quoted by the apostles at Pentecost and quotes the sons/daughters, old/young and servants/handmaids clauses. Both the witness's note 528 and the held canonical Challoner verses identify Joel 2:28-29. The paragraph is not an edge covering all of mixed chapter XVIII.30.
date_basis: The retained Dods 1871 volume I introduction, artifact.augustine.de-civitate-dei.dods-1871.pg45304-body-lf lines 239-243, dates composition of the work from 413 to 426. This ordering key uses the first year of that stated range, as the accepted existing City of God rows do; it does not establish the exact year of this book, chapter or paragraph. The work record has no composed field, and no existing source fingerprint or reviewed binding is changed.
text: I should be obliged to use many words in explaining all that Joel prophesies in order to make clear those that pertain to Christ and the Church. But there is one passage I must not pass by, which the apostles also quoted when the Holy Spirit came down from above on the assembled believers according to Christ's promise. He says, "And it shall come to pass after these things, that I will pour out my Spirit upon all flesh; and your sons and your daughters shall prophesy, and your old men shall dream, and your young men shall see visions: and even on my servants and mine handmaids in those days will I pour out my Spirit."
